vulnerable.description: `getUser()` without `error`, and the always-truthy `data` container tested — a failed authentication takes the signed-in branch
`getSession()` without `error`, and the session dereferenced with no check

safe.description: The result kept whole and its error read off the object — the decoy for a rule keyed on the next line rather than on the binding
`error` not bound, but `data.user` guarded — fail-closed, the documented pattern
`error` not bound, but the session returned to the caller, which decides
